articles.summary: The ASE Environmental Sustainability Foundation (hereinafter referred to as the "Foundation") hosted the summer camp for the "2026 ASE Youth Sustainability Innovation Competition," from July 6 to July 10 at the Jihe Campus of Ming Chuan University. The event brought together ten shortlisted senior and vocational high school teams across northern, central, and southern Taiwan for five days of intensive training.
articles.title: From Creativity to Action: ASE Youth Sustainability Innovation Competition Summer Camp Empowers Youth with Sustainable Action Capabilities
